sgTools.heading: SG Tools - our own brand
paragraphs: Alongside the international manufacturers we import and distribute, Stridon Group also stands behind a tool line of its own. SG TOOLS grew out of a family tool business 30 years in the making.
Every SG TOOLS product carries the same warranty, technical support and service as the brands we import, only with nobody standing between the factory and the shelf.

dck.heading: DCK tools
paragraphs: DCK is the professional brand of Dongcheng, with almost three decades of experience, its own manufacturing and distribution in over a hundred countries.
Here DCK comes with full support: a brushless cordless range, a three-year warranty and service in Serbia. The complete range and the technical detail live on the brand's own site.

inWarranty.title: The tool is under warranty
inWarranty.description: If your tool is still within its warranty period and covered by the manufacturer, we will point you to the brand's authorised service centre. Get in touch and we will find the nearest one for you.

outOfWarranty.title: The tool is out of warranty
outOfWarranty.description: Everything else is handled by SG Servis: routine maintenance, repairs and fault diagnosis. Bring the tool to the service address, or call first to check what you need.

partner.title: SG Servis - our trusted partner
paragraphs: SG Servis has been our partner for power tool repairs for many years. Their team specialises in maintaining and repairing a wide range of brands, from routine servicing and repairs to fault diagnosis.

The technicians have extensive experience with the best-known power tool manufacturers, so neither the model nor the complexity of the fault is an obstacle. Only quality replacement parts go in, so the tool stays dependable after the repair.

Opening hours are 8:00 to 16:00 on weekdays and 9:00 to 15:00 on Saturdays; they are closed on Sundays. Drop by during those hours or call ahead, and the SG Servis team will be glad to help with any question or problem you have with your tool.

hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.description: Your data matters to us. Here you can read how we collect it, use it and protect it.

privacy.body:
The data controller

The site stridon.rs is owned by STRIDON GROUP DOO, registered in the Republic of Serbia. As the data controller, we are responsible for protecting your personal data under the Serbian Personal Data Protection Act.

  • Company: STRIDON GROUP DOO
  • Website: stridon.rs
  • Email: office@stridon.rs

Data protection notice

We are committed to protecting the privacy of everyone who visits our site. This privacy policy explains what data we collect, what we use it for and how we protect it. stridon.rs is an informational site: it presents Stridon Group and the brands we officially import and distribute, and nothing can be bought here. Purchases are made only on prodavnicaalata.rs.

What we collect and why

We do not collect data through a purchase process on this site, because no transactions take place here. We collect data only if you contact us through the contact form, by email, or by requesting access to the B2B platform.

Through the contact form we collect:

  • Your email address
  • The content of your message

Through a B2B access request we also collect the details needed to verify the company:

  • The first and last name of the contact person
  • Email address and phone number
  • Company name and address
  • Tax ID (PIB) and company registration number

We use this data only to:

  • Answer your enquiry or message
  • Provide the information you asked for about brands, catalogs and terms of cooperation
  • Open and verify an account on the B2B platform

Who has access

Your data is accessed only by authorised employees of STRIDON GROUP DOO, for the purpose of handling your enquiry. We do not share your data with third parties unless it is necessary to meet a legal obligation.

How we protect it

We apply appropriate technical and organisational safeguards, including:

  • Server protection using current security protocols
  • Antivirus protection and regular security checks
  • Access limited to authorised employees only

Your rights

Under the Personal Data Protection Act you have the right to:

  • Request access to the data we hold about you
  • Request the correction of inaccurate data
  • Request the deletion of your data
  • Restrict the processing of your data
  • Object to the processing of your data

To exercise any of these rights, write to us at office@stridon.rs.

Supervisory authority

If you believe your data has been processed contrary to the Act, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection of the Republic of Serbia (www.poverenik.rs).

Cookie policy

stridon.rs uses cookies so that the site works correctly and to improve your experience. The cookies we use fall into the following categories:

  • Essential cookies - they make the basic functions of the site work and cannot be turned off.
  • Analytics cookies - they help us understand how visitors use the site so we can improve the content and the experience.
  • Marketing cookies - they are used to show relevant content and advertising.

By using the site you consent to the use of cookies in line with this policy.

Copyright

All content published on stridon.rs, including text, photographs, graphics, logos and design, is protected by copyright and owned by STRIDON GROUP DOO. Reproducing, distributing or otherwise using the content without prior written consent is prohibited.

Changes to this policy

We reserve the right to update this privacy policy at any time. Any change takes effect when it is published on this page. We recommend you read this page again from time to time so you are aware of any changes.
